ouroboros.contracts.v1.AuthenticatedPrin.description: AuthenticatedPrincipalRef is an identity assertion emitted by a trusted boundary.

principalId.description: principal_id is never accepted as caller identity from an untrusted body.

sessionId.description: session_id identifies the authenticated session when a session exists.

tenantId.description: tenant_id is the authenticated tenant context.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.AuthenticatedPrin.title: Authenticated Principal Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.BrainQuery.jsonsc.description: BrainQuery expresses a grounded query without treating request identity as trusted.

freshness.description: freshness controls partial, wait, or abstain behavior.
freshness.title: Freshness Requirement

includeOwnPriorSessions.description: include_own_prior_sessions requests only the caller's own private history.

includeSharedSessions.description: include_shared_sessions requests explicitly shared history only.

knownAt.description: known_at selects historical system knowledge when present.

query.description: query is the user-provided retrieval and synthesis request.

queryId.description: query_id is an opaque query identity for receipts and replay.

repositoryGitOid.description: repository_git_oid pins code retrieval to one immutable Git revision.

requestedPrincipal.description: requested_principal is untrusted input to cross-check with authenticated context.

tokenBudget.description: token_budget caps synthesis and evidence-packing cost.

validAt.description: valid_at selects historical real-world validity when present.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.BrainQuery.jsonsc.title: Brain Query

ouroboros.contracts.v1.BrainScope.jsonsc.description: BrainScope narrows a query to an authorized brain domain.

brainId.description: brain_id identifies the personal, team, project, or company brain.

scopeKind.description: scope_kind is a stable domain kind.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.BrainScope.jsonsc.title: Brain Scope

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier
